name: Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro
author: WP Configurator Addons

sections.description:
Transform the look of your WP Configurator Pro plugin with the Kratos Skin. This visual skin add-on requires a separate purchase of the WP Configurator Pro plugin.

Check Demo

Visit our website to explore all our available skins and add-ons.

What is WP Configurator Pro?

Elevate your eCommerce business with Configurator, the robust product configurator for WordPress and WooCommerce. Effortlessly set up custom product options, allowing customers to personalize products in real time.

Boost your conversion rates and enhance the customer experience with our user-friendly interface and powerful features.

Join over 7,000 businesses and professionals who have leveraged Configurator to take their product customization to new heights.

Buy WP Configurator Pro.

Features

A full window skin with a clean layout, featuring options that are organized in a distinct, uncluttered way.

Ensure a seamless user experience on all devices, from desktop to mobile.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.0 or greater is recommended
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater is recommended

Installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

Sample data

Demo data include in the plugin folder/demo, import kratos-skin.json by clicking Configurator menu, There you can find Import Configurator button, Click that button and choose the kratos-skin.json file from plugin folder and click the Import Now button and wait until it redirects don’t refresh the page.
sections.faq:
Will Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro work with my theme?

Yes! Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro will work with any theme but may require some additional styling.

Where can I report bugs?

Report bugs on the Website.
